title: Grateful Dead Live at Rosemont Horizon Arena on 1989-04-11
lineage: Master Audience Cassette > Nakamichi CR-5A > Emu 1212M > 24/96 wave >  wavelab 5 > Plugins > r8brainpro > 16/44.1 wave > cd wave > flac lvl 8 (TLH)
source: OTS > Nakamichi CM-100's with CP-4 shotgun caps > Sony D-5

ai_review.summary: Clear audience‑sourced recording captures an exciting show highlighted by a fiery Shakedown Street opener and a soaring Terrapin Station.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about the performance, noting the excitement of the set, a strong Shakedown Street opener and a powerful Terrapin Station later in the night. The audience (AUD) recording is praised as clear and lively, with board patches used only sparingly to enhance the mix.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviews are highly positive (4‑5 stars) and emphasize excellent sound quality plus standout performances; limited to two detailed reviews, giving moderate confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear, live feel; board used only for short patch inserts; overall crisp and well‑balanced AUD recording.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Exciting start with Shakedown Street, solid middle, culminating in a soaring Terrapin Station; overall pacing described as solid and lively.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Delivers the goods – strong guitar work praised.
band_member_comments.Bob: Seemed a little under the weather, not as wild as usual.
